intro.title: Africa Gastronomy Botswana
intro.text: Africa Gastronomy Botswana is a platform dedicated to showcasing and promoting African gastronomy — celebrating Botswana's culinary heritage alongside the traditions, chefs and ingredients of the wider continent. Through competitions, masterclasses, exhibitions and cultural exchange, we bring Africa's food story to the world stage.

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.visionText: A continent where African gastronomy is celebrated, preserved and recognised on the global culinary stage — driving pride, tourism and opportunity across Africa.
visionMission.missionText: To create a premier platform that showcases African culinary heritage, empowers chefs and hospitality talent, and connects countries, communities and industry through the shared language of food.

intro.title: Our Story
intro.text: Africa Gastronomy Botswana was founded to give African culinary heritage the stage it deserves — connecting chefs, communities, institutions and industry through a shared celebration of food. FIGA Botswana 2026 marks our flagship event, hosted in Gaborone.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: A continent where African gastronomy is celebrated, preserved and recognised on the global culinary stage.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To create a premier platform that showcases African culinary heritage, empowers chefs and hospitality talent, and connects countries and communities through food.

objectives.title: Objectives
items: Promote and preserve Botswana's and Africa's culinary heritage
Provide a platform for chefs, speakers and hospitality talent to shine
Foster cultural exchange between participating countries
Support tourism, trade and investment through gastronomy
Deliver a professional, world-class event experience in Gaborone

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.text: Africa Gastronomy Botswana is guided by a dedicated organising team and advisory board drawn from the hospitality, culinary and events industries.

heritage.title: Botswana's Culinary Heritage
heritage.text: Botswana's cuisine reflects its land and its people — from seswaa and bogobe to morogo and dried mopane worms, each dish carries the story of community, resilience and celebration.

traditional.title: Traditional Cuisine
traditional.text: Across the continent, traditional cooking techniques — open-fire grilling, slow stewing, fermentation and communal preparation — remain at the heart of African gastronomy.

ingredients.title: Indigenous Ingredients
ingredients.text: Sorghum, millet, indigenous greens, wild fruits and free-range meats form the backbone of dishes that are as nutritious as they are flavourful.

initiatives.title: African Gastronomy Initiatives
initiatives.text: FIGA Botswana champions initiatives that document, preserve and elevate African culinary traditions — from community cookbooks to chef mentorship programmes.
